city.Afghanistan.description: This rugged, mountainous country in Central Asia was a key crossroads of the ancient Silk Road. It is known for towering citadels, blue-tiled mosques, and the elegant long-haired Afghan hound.
city.Afghanistan.landmark: deep blue lakes of Band-e-Amir walled by tall red cliffs
city.Afghanistan.flag: black, red, and green up-and-down stripes with a white mosque and wheat wreath in the middle
city.Afghanistan.clue.0: kept talking about an ancient trading road where camels once crossed high, snowy mountain passes
city.Afghanistan.clue.1: wanted to meet the tall, elegant, long-haired hound dogs first bred in these mountains
city.Armenia.description: This small, mountainous country in the Caucasus was the first in the world to make Christianity its official religion. It is known for ancient stone churches, carved cross-stones, and a huge blue mountain lake.
city.Armenia.landmark: Khor Virap monastery on a hill with snow-capped twin-peaked Mount Ararat rising behind it
city.Armenia.flag: three simple stripes of red, blue, and orange
city.Armenia.clue.0: circled a small mountain country in the Caucasus on a map
city.Armenia.clue.1: kept bragging about visiting the very first country ever to become Christian, full of ancient stone churches
city.Armenia.clue.2: wanted to sketch snowy, twin-peaked Mount Ararat and the carved stone crosses called khachkars
city.Azerbaijan.description: This country in the South Caucasus sits between tall mountains and the Caspian Sea, the world's largest lake. It is nicknamed the "Land of Fire" for its burning hillsides and bubbling mud volcanoes.
city.Azerbaijan.landmark: three curved glass Flame Towers glowing over Baku and the Caspian Sea at night
city.Azerbaijan.flag: blue, red, and green stripes with a white crescent moon and star
city.Azerbaijan.clue.0: kept talking about a hillside where flames have danced out of the rocks for hundreds of years
city.Azerbaijan.clue.1: wanted to see the funny mud volcanoes that pop and burp cold gray mud
city.Azerbaijan.clue.2: packed a purse of leftover manat from an earlier trip
city.Bahrain.description: This tiny island nation in the warm Persian Gulf is a cluster of low, sandy islands whose name means "two seas." Long before oil, it was famous for divers who hunted for pearls in the sea.
city.Bahrain.landmark: solitary Tree of Life standing alone in the empty desert
city.Bahrain.flag: red with a white zigzag band down one side, like a row of little white triangles
city.Bahrain.clue.0: packed for a tiny cluster of low, sandy islands in the warm Persian Gulf
city.Bahrain.clue.1: talked about divers who once plunged deep to hunt for shiny pearls in the sea
city.Bangladesh.description: This low, watery country in South Asia sits on the world's largest river delta. Its Sundarbans, the biggest mangrove forest on Earth, hide the striped Royal Bengal tiger among their tangled roots.
city.Bangladesh.landmark: Royal Bengal tiger at the water's edge in the tangled Sundarbans mangroves
city.Bangladesh.flag: a green field with a big red circle in the middle
